algorithms.name: Fixed NB-IoT
algorithms.principle: Select NB-IoT only when it is feasible; otherwise no selection, with no fallback.
algorithms.limitation: Cannot exploit 5G when NB-IoT is unavailable or deadline-infeasible.

algorithms.name: Fixed 5G
algorithms.principle: Select 5G only when it is feasible; otherwise no selection, with no fallback.
algorithms.strength: Low latency in the configured model.
algorithms.limitation: Does not fall back to NB-IoT when 5G is unavailable.

algorithms.name: Latency-first
algorithms.principle: Choose the feasible candidate with the lowest predicted latency.
algorithms.limitation: Does not balance energy, reliability and bandwidth together.

algorithms.name: Energy-first
algorithms.principle: Choose the feasible candidate with the lowest instantaneous marginal energy estimate.
algorithms.limitation: Not horizon-aware; does not forecast future modem wake-ups.

algorithms.name: Static AHP-TOPSIS
algorithms.principle: Use equal weights and rank feasible candidates with TOPSIS.
algorithms.strength: Balances four criteria with a fixed vector.
algorithms.limitation: Does not adapt weights to gateway state.

algorithms.name: Adaptive AHP-TOPSIS
algorithms.principle: Use state-specific design weights and rank feasible alternatives with TOPSIS.
algorithms.strength: Changes criterion priorities by gateway state.
algorithms.limitation: 5G dominates all primary ranking calls under configured model inputs.

events.detail: 5G base latency rises from 20 ms to 150 ms for 60 s.

limitations: Logical simulation, not a physical network deployment.
Detailed LoRaWAN PHY/MAC, airtime, collisions and deduplication are abstracted.
Full LTE/EPC and 5G Core protocol stacks are not implemented.
N3IWF and ATSSS are not implemented.
No physical radio or commercial modem measurements are included.
AHP preferences are design-specified rather than expert-elicited.
The primary adaptive AHP-TOPSIS run selected 5G in every recorded ranking decision.
The five-seed outage/recovery pilot is supplementary and exploratory.
6G/IMT-2030 is future work; no 6G radio or core is simulated.

tsc_matrix.energy_boundary: Includes configured CPU, setup and transmission energy; excludes calibrated modem idle-tail/sleep leakage and switching energy.
limitations: PDR and emergency PDR have no Holm-significant improvements.
No reduction in packet-selection changes is established.
No overall modelled-energy reduction is established.
6G profile is not selectable or simulated.
